title: Dynamical mean-field limit and replica-symmetric free energy for the orthogonally-invariant SK model
summary: We study a class of diffusion processes on $\mathbb{R}^n$ interacting through a symmetric matrix $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$. When eigenvectors of $X$ are Haar-uniform on the orthogonal group, we derive a dynamical mean-field limit for the empirical law of sample paths, extending the classical Sompolinsky--Zippelius characterization for $X\sim\mathrm{GOE}$.
